description: Defines a template class BroadcastRing for a lock-free, concurrent ring buffer used in inter-process communication, with traits for static or dynamic sizing, including methods for creation, import, and record access, along with detailed comments and usage examples.

classes.name: BroadcastRing
classes.description: A template class implementing a lock-free, concurrent ring buffer for inter-process communication, supporting static and dynamic sizing, with methods for creation, import, and record access.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new ring at a given memory mapping with specified record count.

methods.name: Import
methods.description: Imports an existing ring from a memory mapping, returning a tuple of the ring and a success boolean.

methods.name: MemorySize
methods.description: Calculates the memory size needed for a ring with a given record count.

methods.name: GetRecordCount
methods.description: Calculates the maximum record count that fits into a given mmap size.

methods.name: Put
methods.description: Writes a record into the ring, overwriting oldest if full.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves the oldest record with sequence >= given sequence.

methods.name: GetNewest
methods.description: Retrieves the newest record with sequence >= given sequence.
